findings.claim: GetPropertyIdentifierLocation still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] unguarded, despite its doc comment claiming null is returned for metadata properties. For a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly, the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path still throws IndexOutOfRangeException. The exception escapes the generator and analyzer, which causes CS8785/AD0001 and silently drops the generated resolver, so the crash is not fixed. This is also an availability issue, because a crashing generator disables protections. The ReportIfLocatedInCompilation filter runs only after Diagnostic.Create has evaluated the argument, so it cannot prevent the throw.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generator/analyzer test with a referenced-assembly compilation containing a [MessagePackObject] generic struct Item<T> whose property has a [Key] attribute with null int and string key, or other trigger of the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull path. Use it as a member of a source type and assert no exception and no AD0001/CS8785. It fails with IndexOutOfRangeException at line 1432. Alternatively, mutate [0] to FirstOrDefault()?. and see the test pass.

findings.claim: The cast (PropertyDeclarationSyntax)...GetSyntax() in GetPropertyIdentifierLocation is unchecked. Properties declared in source as something other than PropertyDeclarationSyntax, such as a positional record parameter synthesized property (ParameterSyntax), would throw InvalidCastException. The record-struct repro in the requirement uses positional properties. Throwing in the analyzer or generator disables generation and diagnostics.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the analyzer on a [MessagePackObject] record with a positional property lacking a key, such as [property: Key(null)] or a similar BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull trigger. Assert no InvalidCastException; compare with the prior code, which had the same cast.

findings.claim: The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation filter silently drops every diagnostic whose location is not in the compilation's syntax trees. This includes diagnostics created with a null Location (Location.None), such as MemberNeedsKey now built with FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax().GetLocation(). Any security-protective diagnostic for such a case, e.g. MsgPack004 errors, is suppressed without notice, which the requirement does not call for. The filter is applied to all diagnostics, a broader change than the crash fix.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the existing analyzer tests (MsgPack003/004/005 etc.) and a case where a diagnostic has Location.None; assert that diagnostics previously reported are still reported.
